newsitem.title: GREECE: LEFT COALITION SLAMS MAJOR PARTIES.
newsitem.headline: LEFT COALITION SLAMS MAJOR PARTIES.

text.p: The president of Left Coalition, Nikos Konstandopoulos, blasted conservative leader Militiades for violating campaign rules and socialist premier Costas Simitis for anti-democratic views.
Konstandopoulos accused Evert of attempting to violate commonly agreed campaign rules to serve his election interests.
"This behaviour is unacceptable. It is imperative that Mr Evert stops behaving in this way," he said in a statement.
Evert postponed a television interview with three reporters scheduled for tonight and analysts said he was trying to push it to Friday night after the socialists' mass rally in Athens.
The president of Left Coalition party is scheduled to give a televised interview to reporters on Friday night.
Konstandopoulos also slammed Simitis for anti-democratic behaviour that has nothing to do with modernisation because of his frequent reference to the electorate law.

The electoral law favours the leading party at the expense of the second runner-up and Simitis has made emotional appeals to leftist voters in an attempt to lure them to the PASOK fold. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
